title: Sosarmon
summary: Raleigh names Sosarmon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sosarmon, in Annius his list of the Median Kings, who raigned thirtie yeeres. That list was not equated with Eusebius his Sosarmus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. IV, sig. 353a
